title: u32 multiplication overflow in pipe_effective_capacity: raw * permille unguarded
detail: capacity_units is validated only > 0 (i32 up to ~2.1e9) while permille reaches 1000; raw*permille wraps u32 for capacity_units above ~4.29e6, silently yielding a wrong capacity — against the diff's own ODN-5 fail-fast bar for permille.
recommended_fix: Compute in u64 (u64(raw) * permille / 1000), or bound capacity_units*1000 <= max(u32) at catalog load alongside the permille range check.

title: Demo modernize pipe id: u64 parse result truncated to u32 without range check
detail: parse_uint returns u64; a pipe id >= 2^32 (e.g. 4294967296 -> 0) parses ok and silently truncates in u32(fid), retargeting the modernize onto a different live pipe; only a nonexistent id is caught later via replay_error.
recommended_fix: Reject after parse: if fid > max(u32) return the bad-modernize-pipe-id error line before appending the intent.
